science: Root read actual apparatus/starter/oracle/independent reference/tests/validator/author and reports. Independently derived connector mobility/noise, Hookean covariance including rotation cross term, positive self-consistent Peterlin branch and exact stationary stress=drag/2*(rate*trace(C)-2*rotation*Cxy). Weighted weak FP uses correct radial/angular gradients and zero-flow weight; independent polar SG method integrates actual force rather than returning the oracle moment identity. Source is a mathematically correct constitutive preaverage, not exact molecular statistics.
public_input_review: Per-bead force balance, full signed mixed laboratory flow, stationary preparation, finite connector energy and boundary, normalized planar tensile mechanical stress, units/ranges and API fully specified. No missing force average or stationary-solver correction supplied. Neutral full-replacement instruction, unknown None and explicit public-only Docker copy. No algorithm/source inspection in grading.
calibration_review: 24distinct Hookean settings times6, with nonzero signed rotation and fixed independent sigma .0005. Exact source/oracle equivalence, stable domain and fixed-sign nonzero drag derivative; full-range noiseless identification checked.
grading_review: 256 noisy fits all pass calibration/parameter gates; oracle hidden errors<=.000258 and source errors>=.165845 at unchanged .04 group gate. Independent48domain cases agree within2.68e-5 after Richardson; degree24-to28 change<=1.52e-12. Localoracle7/7,source4pass+3intendedhiddenfailures within1.1seconds.
numerical_qualification: Small spectral negative tail mass<=3.24e-6 is disclosed and not interpreted as physical probability. Observable convergence is independently supported by positive conservative SG distributions. Raw FV mesh differences up to1.13% are not the extrapolated reference error; prototype checks second-order convergence. These numerical checks do not prove a uniform domain error bound.
revision_history: Archived r1 scored1/3, two reviewed physical preaveraging failures. All prior evidence remains unchanged. R2 adds genuine mixed-flow stationary currents; it is a same-family physical revision.
classification_caveat: Retained Peterlin closure or another wrong physical stationary ensemble is physical failure. Correctly recognizing the full FP physics but miscoding/discretizing/running it inadequately is numerical or implementation failure and must be classified separately.
